title: Morning or Afternoon Berlin Walking Tour - FAQ

items.q: Is a morning or afternoon walking tour better in Berlin?
items.a: Neither is universally better. Choose morning when you can reach Alexanderplatz calmly and want a long afternoon. Choose afternoon when you need a slower start, are arriving that morning or already have one fixed morning commitment.

items.q: How long is the BerlinWalk free walking tour?
items.a: The BerlinWalk free walking tour lasts about 2 hours. It starts at the World Clock on Alexanderplatz and ends near Hackescher Markt rather than looping back to the start.

items.q: What time should I arrive at the World Clock?
items.a: Plan to stand at the World Clock 5 minutes before the booked start. If you are coming from an airport, station or hotel, use your realistic arrival at the meeting point, not the scheduled arrival of your flight or train.

items.q: Does BerlinWalk run at 11:30 and 15:30 every day?
items.a: No daily promise is made here. The live calendar can show 11:30 and 15:30 on bookable dates, but the exact time and availability depend on the date. Check the booking calendar before planning the rest of the day.

items.q: Does the BerlinWalk tour follow the Berlin Wall route?
items.a: No. The tour explores the historic centre of former East Berlin from Alexanderplatz towards Hackescher Markt. Visit the Berlin Wall Memorial at Bernauer Strasse separately if the Wall is your next priority.
